_comment: Plugin-shipped background monitors. Per code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins, monitors run a long-lived shell command and notify Claude when its output produces new lines. ALL ENTRIES BELOW ARE COMMENTED OUT — uncomment what you actually want and adjust paths.

monitors._comment: Watch a build/error log. Uncomment 'enabled' to activate.
monitors.name: build-log
monitors.description: Watch the build log; surface new errors to Claude.

monitors._comment: Watch CI by polling the gh CLI every 30s. Disabled by default; needs gh auth.
monitors.name: ci-watch
monitors.command: while true; do gh run list --limit 1 --json status,conclusion --jq '.[0] | "\(.status) \(.conclusion // "-")"'; sleep 30; done
monitors.description: Surface CI status changes; pairs with verify-loop.

monitors._comment: Watch a verify-loop output stream. Uncomment after wiring the project's verify command.
monitors.name: verify-stream
monitors.description: Surface verify-command output as it produces lines.
